name: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk
summary: PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk engages in the provision of internet services in Indonesia. The company offers data center interconnection, SD-WAN networking, colocation, multi-service port, cloud-centric enterprise network, and managed service network solutions. It also provides cable telecommunication, data communication system, and internet interconnection services, as well as resale of telecommunication services. The company was founded in 2016 and is based in Jakarta Selatan, Indonesia. PT Sinergi Inti Andalan Prima Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Abadi Kreasi Unggul Nusantara.
